# Project Rudis — External Reading Hub

This directory is the **public external-facing navigation layer** for Project Rudis.

It exists to let investors, strategic partners, technical reviewers, institutions and research collaborators understand Rudis progressively without confusing public architecture, private implementation, research evidence, commercial negotiation or constitutional authority.

> **One project. Different audiences. Progressive disclosure. No contradictory narratives.**

Core boundaries:

```text
PUBLIC ARCHITECTURE != PRIVATE FORGE
TECHNICAL PROGRESS != PRODUCTION READINESS
INVESTMENT != CANON CONTROL
NDA != UNRESTRICTED ACCESS
RESEARCH FINDING != LAW
```

Current public maturity:

```text
PRE-D3 = ACTIVE
D3 OPEN = NO
D4 / PRODUCTION = NO
REAL CUSTOMERS = NO
REAL MONEY = NO
```

## 6. Financing architecture

These documents should be read as one coherent financing stack:

```text
PROJECT / PRODUCT THESIS
-> MATURITY
-> STRATEGIC FIT
-> FUNDING STRATEGY
-> CAPITAL STRUCTURE
-> FOUNDER / TEAM CONTINUITY
-> TERM SHEET
-> DEFINITIVE AGREEMENTS
```

Relevant documents:

- [Funding Strategy & Target Ladder 2026](./Funding_Strategy_and_Target_Ladder_2026.md)
- [Financing Readiness Checklist](./Financing_Readiness_Checklist.md)
- [Financing Principles & Founder Autonomy](./Financing_Principles_and_Founder_Autonomy.md)
- [Founder Compensation & Continuity Framework](./Founder_Compensation_and_Continuity_Framework.md)
- [Founder Autonomy Clause Bank](./Founder_Autonomy_Clause_Bank.md)
- [Capital Structure Options](./Capital_Structure_Options.md)
- [Strategic Financing Term Sheet Framework](./Strategic_Financing_Term_Sheet_Framework.md)

No single financing document should be read as a securities offer or final transaction instrument.

## 8. Recommended disclosure sequence

```text
PUBLIC ONE-PAGER
-> INVESTOR INTRODUCTION
-> TECHNICAL / STRATEGIC REVIEW
-> SANITIZED DILIGENCE
-> NDA
-> PURPOSE-BOUND RESTRICTED REVIEW
-> TERM DISCUSSION
-> DEFINITIVE AGREEMENT
```

This sequence is a navigation and disclosure discipline, not a mandatory legal process.

---

## Final orientation

Rudis should be externally understandable without becoming externally capturable.

> **Make the thesis easy to understand, the limits impossible to miss, the evidence progressively inspectable, and authority impossible to purchase by implication.**
